text: Liu/Wang abstract reports more selective Chinese AI-related recruitment, including postgraduate and one-to-five-year experience requirements, in over one million 2018–2025 ads.
locator: What evidence says about experience; public abstract
limitations: Abstract/preview only; full methods unappraised. Ads are not hires; no national youth-employment causal inference.

text: Fourteen South Korean software-worker interviews report junior tasks being taken on in senior-plus-AI workflows.
limitations: Network sample of 8 junior/6 senior; qualitative accounts, not prevalence or China/Malaysia outcomes. No invented illustrative analyst or causal pathway.

text: Less-experienced/lower-skilled workers gained more in a 5172-agent customer-support study, mostly Philippines-based. Rollout mainly autumn2020 and winter2021.
limitations: Non-random workplace rollout. Employed agents at one firm and contractors; productivity, not recruitment.

text: Authors describe about2.5 resolutions/hour at about2 months with AI from joining versus8–10months without.
limitations: Approximate descriptions, not exact target-time calculation, confidence interval, guarantee or Malaysian forecast.

text: China reports a talent supply-demand data platform and forecasting for urgent fields to inform education programme changes.
locator: China planning section; final paragraph of supply-demand matching section
limitations: Official process account; underlying model and forecast accuracy not appraised; no shortage reduction inferred.

text: 2024 undergraduate round:1839 offerings added,2220 stopped admissions,1428 withdrawn,157 degree-category/duration changes; reported22April2025.
locator: Cover chart and China section; announcement opening
limitations: Institution-level offerings, not places, subjects, graduates or jobs. No summed net effect or causal policy effect.

text: The 2025 undergraduate catalogue adds29 subjects including AI education and low-altitude technology/engineering.
locator: China section; announcement catalogue paragraph and green-channel paragraph
limitations: Catalogue additions and strategic intent; not numbers of graduates or realised demand.

text: China issued758 new/revised vocational teaching standards in February2025, covering82.1% of institution-level offerings recorded in2024; includes practical, advanced-manufacturing and digital/AI teaching.
locator: China TVET paragraph; Q&A scope and characteristics3–5
limitations: Administrative standards coverage; not student share, implemented quality, measured shortage reduction or effectiveness.

text: DOSM estimates195.7k vacancies inQ22026:107.3k semi-skilled,50.2k skilled,38.2k low-skilled.
locator: Malaysia vacancies section/chart; official skills breakdown
limitations: Covered registered private-sector survey, not total economy. Rounded estimates; not TVET qualification, fresh-graduate or physical-work counts. No error interval supplied in overview.

text: Manufacturing contributes114.0k or58.3% of the same Q22026 vacancies.
locator: Malaysia paragraph after chart; economic activity breakdown
limitations: Sector/skill cuts of same total, not additive. No attribution to AI and no demonstrated reason vacancies remain open.

text: ILO2025 assesses clerical work most exposed and manual tasks less exposed to GenAI; uses survey responses, experts and AI with equal task weights.
limitations: Published data-based assessment; ratings are not observed automation. Equal weights and cross-country applicability remain assumptions; no Malaysian demand or all-automation forecast adopted. Initial AI scoring used models available at end2024; not a measurement of October2026 technology.

text: These records do not establish universal senior AI advantage, reliable Chinese forecast accuracy or an AI-caused future TVET boom.
limitations: Evidence-bound scope judgment, not proof that the outcomes can never occur; questions left open.
